title: Hey folks, you shared quite useful feedback here previously so wanted to share a demo for another round.
author: ykosyakov
selftext:
Today I got a pretty "lukewarm" reception at r/incremental_games haha. Still hard for people to embrace the new reality, but let's what will happen in a few months or a year with AI perception in gamedev.

  
Anyway, a bit of advice from someone deep into software engineering and a bit of gamedev:

Don't underestimate how important you playing on your game, on every aspect of that, every corner should be checked. In software engineering it's already solved in many ways with agents, but in gamedev it's not easy to do, though I bet big studios already experimenting with synthetic players. So, test your games however you made it.

  
Link to the demo: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527800/No\_Asteroids/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527800/No_Asteroids/)
